newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to 25.655 bln stg in week to June 25.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to 25.655 bln stg in week to June 25.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.655 billion stg in the week to June 25 from 25.488 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis M0 rose to 25.623 billion stg from 25.401 billion.

Notes and coins in circulation rose to 25.350 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.288 billion the previous week and to 25.318 billion from 25.201 billion on an unadjusted basis. -- London Newsroom 44 171 542 7715
